description: Source code for a GUI dialog class 'Param_panel' in the BORIS behavioral observation software, managing user interactions for selecting subjects, behaviors, and time intervals.

classes.name: Param_panel
classes.description: A dialog class for parameter selection in BORIS, handling UI components and user interactions for subjects, behaviors, and time intervals.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dialog, setting up UI components, and connecting signals.

methods.name: cb_exclude_non_coded_modifiers_visibility
methods.description: Sets visibility and enabled state of the 'exclude non-coded modifiers' checkbox based on 'include modifiers' checkbox.

methods.name: rb_time_interval_selection
methods.description: Handles enabling/disabling and setting visibility of time interval widgets based on selected time mode.

methods.name: subjects_button_clicked
methods.description: Selects, unselects, or reverses selection of subject checkboxes.

methods.name: behaviors_button_clicked
methods.description: Selects, unselects, or reverses selection of behavior list items.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Collects selected subjects and behaviors and accepts the dialog.

methods.name: behavior_item_clicked
methods.description: Checks or unchecks behaviors belonging to a clicked category.

methods.name: extract_observed_behaviors
methods.description: Extracts unique behavior codes from selected observations and subjects.

methods.name: cb_changed
methods.description: Updates behavior check states based on selected subjects.
